# heist_applications (Data Source)

Lists the applications in the workspace that match every filter set, including applications Heist discovered and ones created outside Terraform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Applications Heist discovered under a main target that need review.
data "heist_application" "app" {
  url = "https://app.example.com"
}

data "heist_applications" "needs_review" {
  parent_application_id = data.heist_application.app.id
  requires_review       = true
}

output "needs_review" {
  value = data.heist_applications.needs_review.applications[*].url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `in_scope` (Boolean) Only applications that are (`true`) or are not (`false`) in testing scope.
- `parent_application_id` (String) Only applications discovered under the application with this ID.
- `requires_review` (Boolean) Only applications that do (`true`) or do not (`false`) need review.
- `root_only` (Boolean) Only applications without a parent application when `true`.
- `search` (String) Only applications matching this text, as the Heist API's application search defines it.

### Read-Only

- `applications` (Attributes List) Matching applications. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--applications))

<a id="nestedatt--applications"></a>
### Nested Schema for `applications`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) When the application was created.
- `domain` (String) Workspace domain the application belongs to, for example `example.com` for `app.example.com`.
- `environment` (String) Environment of the application, or null when unset.
- `git_repository` (Attributes) Git repository attached to the application, or null when none is. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--applications--git_repository))
- `id` (String) Application ID.
- `in_scope` (Boolean) Whether Heist tests the application.
- `main_target` (Boolean) Whether the application is a main target rather than one discovered by Heist.
- `missing_auth` (Boolean) Whether the application needs authentication Heist does not have.
- `parent_application_ids` (List of String) IDs of the applications this one was discovered under. Empty for root applications.
- `requires_review` (Boolean) Whether the application needs review in Heist.
- `url` (String) Application URL.

<a id="nestedatt--applications--git_repository"></a>
### Nested Schema for `applications.git_repository`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Repository name.
- `owner` (String) Repository owner or organization.
- `project` (String) Project containing the repository, or null when the provider has none.
- `provider` (String) Git hosting provider.
